notes.title: Version 1.1 Released
notes.notes:
While version 1.1 won't fix all the controller problems that people may be having, we hope that by changing our serialization format from .CSV to .JSON, we can fix some of the regional issues caused by the .CSV format.

Thank you for alerting us to the controller issues and we hope to keep fixing bugs as you keep pointing them out!

notes.title: Release Date For Beta 4 Announced
notes.notes:
Hi everyone! Sorry Beta 4 is later than expected, but we now have a hard deadline for it: April 26th, 2018. This update will include the following:

[olist]
[*] Recenter camera option in options menu in Lobby
[*] New paddles
[*] System optimizations
[*] New Achievements
[/olist]

Thanks for your patience during development and we very much appreciate your support!
